# hls4ml_SNN_Conversion

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A methodology for translating trained spiking neural network models into FPGA-synthesizable hardware descriptions via high-level synthesis, preserving spike-based temporal dynamics. Facilitates rapid prototyping and hardware-software co-design, reducing the gap between neuromorphic algorithms and TCC/iNEST hardware implementations.
